threads.author: Stephenie Yong
threads.summary: Livit Jotform confirmation emails render dates as mm/dd/yy instead of the international dd/mm/yy, and preferred scan time isn't a required field on the Jotform, so confirmations come through showing 12:00 AM.
threads.note: Stephenie confirmed she'll wait for updates - next action is on the CS Apps team to fix the date format and make preferred scan time compulsory on the Livit Jotform.

threads.author: Troy Lowry
threads.summary: On revisit job SWC-7363_RV the adjustment line item keeps populating a job rate even with the client price code set to "Refer to Parent" - they want the client charged nothing while still paying the CT a custom amount.
threads.note: {Job Rate} resolves as Job Rate 2.0 or 1.0 plus {Adjustment Job Rate}, so the client price code alone won't zero it; SWC-7363_RV doesn't resolve in Global Requests, so Troy has been asked for the Airtable record link or Record Number.
